selector.why: The presence of perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates, exocytosis of atypical lymphocytes, and a high CD4 to CD8 ratio, along with the demonstration of monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement, are highly specific findings that point towards this diagnosis.
